item.title: Israeli officials say Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei has been killed. No word from US or Iran
item.description: Israeli officials told The Associated Press that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has been killed.

item.title: Actor Shia LaBeouf arrested again on battery charge in New Orleans
item.description: Court records in New Orleans show that actor Shia LaBeouf has been rearrested and charged with an additional count of simple battery.

item.title: Iran’s supreme leader is dead following major attack by US and Israel
item.description: Trump says Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is dead, calls it 'greatest chance' for Iranians to take back the country.

item.title: Pentagon and Scouting America reach deal to keep ties after Hegseth’s anti-DEI push
item.description: The Pentagon has made a deal with Scouting America that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Friday would maintain their century-old partnership but refocus the organization away from diversity initiatives and other "woke" policies he accused it of embracing in recent years.

item.title: Greg Abel praises Warren Buffett and promises Berkshire Hathaway won’t retreat from investing
item.description: Greg Abel paid tribute to his predecessor Warren Buffett while promising in his first shareholder letter that Berkshire Hathaway won't retreat from investing or make significant changes in the way it operates.

item.title: US and Israel clash with Iran at emergency Security Council meeting. UN chief condemns attacks
item.description: The United States and Israel have clashed with Iran at an emergency meeting of the U.N. Security Council, where the U.N. chief and many countries urged a halt to their attacks and a return to negotiations.

item.title: U.S. military says three service members have been killed, five seriously wounded in the Iran operation
item.description: Israel and Iran are trading strikes as part of a widening war after the killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a surprise U.S. and Israeli bombardment a day earlier. Blasts in Tehran — whose target was not immediately clear — sent a huge plume of smoke into the sky in an area where there are government buildings. item.title: Suspect in Texas shooting wore ‘Property of Allah’ clothing and Iranian flag emblem, AP source says
item.description: A law enforcement official tells The Associated Press that the gunman who killed two people at a bar in Texas early Sunday was wearing a sweatshirt that said “Property of Allah,” and another shirt with an Iranian flag design.

item.title: Two people ejected from their car in crash
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY — At least one person has died after a single-vehicle crash on Northbound I-15 near 3300 South in South Salt Lake City.

item.title: Neighbors upset that Ogden Regional Medical Center cut down dozens of trees
item.description: Residents near Ogden Regional Medical Center said they are shocked that the hospital cut down dozens of trees that separated homes from the hospital property.
